```plato
//==
// # Boundary representation (BREP) shell types
//
// The immutable faceted BREP v1: `Brep3D` is vertices + undirected edges +
// faces, faces bound themselves with oriented edge-uses, and edge/face
// geometry lives in the `BrepCurve` / `BrepSurface` sum types (Line only, and
// Planar | Bilinear, in v1 — curved cases are added as new sum cases). See
// brep.concepts.plato for the edge-use-vs-half-edge convention and the
// closedness-is-a-proof rule (no `ClosedShell` marker here). Loops traverse a
// face boundary counter-clockwise as seen from outside the solid, and the
// surface normal (du x dv) points out of the solid.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.

// The direction a face cites an undirected edge with: Forward walks the edge
// from its Start vertex to its End vertex, Reversed walks it back.
type EdgeOrientation = Forward | Reversed;
```
